meta.title: HRMS
meta.description: A human resources management system for job seekers and employers. Post openings and manage every application in one place.

hero.subtitle: One résumé for job seekers, one dashboard for employers. Publish an opening, follow every application, and run the whole process from the same place.
hero.pipelineCaption: Every application's status on one screen

audience.title: Two sides, one system
audience.subtitle: The same data, shown so it is useful to both.

seeker.label: For job seekers
seeker.title: Write it once, use it in every application
seeker.stepOne: Create your account and fill in the basics.
seeker.stepTwo: Build your résumé — education, experience, skills, projects — and upload your files.
seeker.stepThree: Apply to an opening in one click and track its status from your dashboard.
seeker.cta: Sign up as a job seeker

employer.label: For employers
employer.title: Open the role, manage the pipeline
employer.stepOne: Set up your company profile and departments.
employer.stepTwo: Publish an opening with its position, skills, salary range and closing date.
employer.stepThree: Review each applicant's résumé, update the status, leave a note.

features.title: What's inside
features.subtitle: Not decoration — the parts that do the work.
features.cvBody: Education, experience, skills, languages and projects in their own fields, not one block of free text.
features.filesBody: Upload a PDF; your files are visible only to you and to an employer you applied to.
features.postingsBody: Openings searchable by skill, city and free text, with salary range and employment type.
features.trackingBody: Submitted, under review, interview, offer, accepted, rejected — every step is recorded.
features.moderationBody: System staff moderate users, postings and applications from a single place.
features.languageBody: Switch the interface language in one click; your choice is remembered next visit.

cta.title: All it takes to start is an account
cta.subtitle: Job seeker or employer — signing up is free, and browsing openings needs no account at all.
cta.signedInTitle: Pick up where you left off

footer.tagline: An open-source human resources application that puts both sides of hiring in the same system.
